page.layout: One printed page. One column of running text, no margin notes. At the foot, the signature "L 4" and the catchword "lumen" at the right. Running head at the top.

main_text.p: tiendi imbutis ipsa utitur, veluti ad colo-res recipiendum oculis, ad voces & sonos audiendum auribus, ad sapores percipien-dum lingua, ad odores olfaciendum nari-bus, demum ad tactiles qualitates cogno-scendum, corporis cute. Ergo animales spi-ritus haudquaqua sensuum motus, & prin-cipum actionum animae organa propria sunt, sed communia, remoraque, sine quibus ta-men, nec alia quidem sunt, neque agunt. Etenim cerebrū illustrant, & neruos aliasq; partes corporis sensu praeditas: rerū quoq; species ab exterioribus sensibus perceptas ad ipsum cerebrum transferunt, ubi facul-tas dignoscendi alterationes instrumentis sensuum inductas sita esse existimatur, quam sensum communem physici nuncupant. Quinetiam ipsas rerū species, imaginesq; in cerebri ventriculis & substantia, si spiri-tus conservant. Sunt enim (sicut ante dixi-mus) praecipua animae sedes, & organum primarium. Idcirco imaginandi, ratiocinan-di, & memorandi vim in sese continent. Ner ui quoq;, licet eiusdem substantiae sint cum ipso cerebro, nihilominus tamen ex se nul-lam sentiendi movendiq; vim habent, sed a cerebro peripsos spiritus, quomodo aer

page.notes: The line "Ner / ui quoq;" breaks without a printed hyphen; read as "Nerui quoq;" with the join unclear. Printed "Neruiquoq" is likely; the scan does not show a hyphen. Doubtful: "indu&tas" read as "inductas". Show-through marks in the right margin ignored. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised.
